$comment: Tier 2 markets. The weather is measurable, the consequence is a judgement. GDACS is the European Commission Joint Research Centre's global disaster registry: it answers a date range, an event type and a country with GeoJSON, and every record carries an alert level, the affected countries and a numeric severity. Because the feed is structured, the contract counts the qualifying records itself and the model only has to quote the record it relied on. The MeteoAlarm feeds are the European weather alerting network in CAP format. The feed retention is short, so the resolution deadline has to be close to the event.

markets.question: Will GDACS record at least 1 flood event affecting Indonesia in December 2026?
markets.criteria: Count the records in the Global Disaster Alert and Coordination System that report a flood, that list Indonesia among the countries they affected, and that are orange or red. Resolve Yes if the count is at least 1.
markets.metric_name: number of orange or red flood events affecting Indonesia

measurement.station: not applicable, this market measures the GDACS global disaster registry
measurement.variable: the number of qualifying disaster records
measurement.day_boundary: the from and to dates of the record
measurement.missing_data: the market is voided if the registry answers with nothing at all

event.publisher: GDACS, the Joint Research Centre of the European Commission
event.criteria: a record counts when it is a flood, when it lists Indonesia among the affected countries and when its alert level is orange or red

markets.criteria: Count the records in the Global Disaster Alert and Coordination System that list Indonesia among the countries they affected and that are orange or red, whatever their type. Resolve Yes if the count is at least 3.
markets.metric_name: number of orange or red disaster events affecting Indonesia

measurement.station: not applicable, this market measures the GDACS global disaster registry
measurement.variable: the number of qualifying disaster records
measurement.day_boundary: the from and to dates of the record
measurement.missing_data: the market is voided if the registry answers with nothing at all

event.publisher: GDACS, the Joint Research Centre of the European Commission
event.criteria: a record counts when it lists Indonesia among the affected countries and when its alert level is orange or red

markets.question: Will MeteoAlarm record at least 3 areas in Poland with an orange wind warning on 14 December 2026?
markets.criteria: Count the entries in the MeteoAlarm feed for Poland whose event is a wind warning and whose severity is orange, counting each area once. Resolve Yes if the count is at least 3.
markets.metric_name: number of areas with an orange wind warning

measurement.station: not applicable, this market measures the MeteoAlarm alerting network
measurement.variable: the number of qualifying warning entries
measurement.day_boundary: the onset and expiry of the warning
measurement.missing_data: the market is voided if the feed publishes nothing at all

event.publisher: MeteoAlarm, the European weather alerting network
event.criteria: an entry counts when its event is a wind warning and its severity is orange, and each area counts once

markets.question: Will the US National Weather Service have any watch, warning or advisory in force for New York State on 14 December 2026?
markets.criteria: Look for any alert in the National Weather Service feed that covers New York State and is in force on 14 December 2026. Resolve Yes if there is at least one, No if there is none.

measurement.station: not applicable, this market measures the National Weather Service alert feed
measurement.variable: the presence of a qualifying alert
measurement.day_boundary: the effective and expiry times of the alert
measurement.missing_data: the market is voided if the feed publishes nothing at all

event.publisher: the US National Weather Service, api.weather.gov
event.criteria: any alert of any type that covers New York State and is in force on the day counts
